skillSourceManifest.behavior: Discovers founder-owned skill files under the configured FCR skills root, hashes source, records status/scope/owner, and exposes prompt/resource references to FCR and Chief while tool exposure remains false.

externalSkillIntake.behavior: Candidate discovery only; external skills remain QUARANTINED with executionAllowed false until pinned revision, license, security, sandbox, compatibility, and founder-approval gates pass.

externalSecurityCatalog.behavior: Read-only documentation/provenance catalog; execution disabled, auto-fetch disabled, and auto-handoff disabled.

governance.promptosBoundary: PromptOS owns catalog and compatibility resolution only. It must not create a competing approval, installation, execution, or distribution authority.
governance.treeScan: Recursive Git Trees API main-branch snapshots are pinned per repository in records[].treeSnapshot; each snapshot retains tree SHA, truncation state, skill count, every SKILL.md path and blob SHA.

classificationRules: SKILL.md under skills/ is treated as a candidate canonical or product-native package; inspect frontmatter and owner/status before assigning authority.
SKILL.md under .agents/, .claude/, .ai/ or .github/skills/ is treated as an agent/provider adapter or local entrypoint until canonical source and content hash are reconciled.
systems/skills/ is treated as a shared operating-skill export; copies are deduplicated by blob SHA and lifecycle metadata, not by filename alone.
plugins/**/SKILL.md is a plugin-scoped capability package, not automatically a product-owned skill.
skills-lock.json records external package references and hashes; it does not by itself prove the package is installed, active, compatible, or authorized.
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GLOBAL_AI.md and docs/MCP_SKILL_ROUTING.md are repository instructions or routing contracts, not standalone SKILL.md packages.
